notes.title: First Sale for Mega Man Battle Network Legacy Collection!
notes.content:
[h3][b]■Mega Man Battle Network Legacy Collection on sale![/b][/h3]
This collection featuring all 10 mainline games in the Mega Man Battle Network series is now available at a discount!
https://store.steampowered.com/sub/821963/
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1798010/Mega_Man_Battle_Network_Legacy_Collection_Vol_1/
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1798020/Mega_Man_Battle_Network_Legacy_Collection_Vol_2/

[h3][b]■Mega Man TGS Pack and digital sale now on![/b][/h3]
We are offering a "Mega Man TGS Pack" for a limited time! Make sure to grab it while it's still available!
https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/34883/ROCKMAN_TGS_PACK/

[h3][b]■Other popular Capcom titles are currently discounted as part of the Capcom Tokyo Game Show sale![/b][/h3]
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/developer/capcom/sale/tgs][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43107541/7bc4350d4f97c72fafe409558e05baf2523999c0.jpg[/img][/url]

[h3][b]■MEGA MAN X DiVE Offline now available![/b][/h3]
MEGA MAN X DiVE returns in an offline format with more than 900 stages and over 100 playable characters from all mainline series in the Mega Man franchise! "DiVE" into the scrambled cyberworld known as the Deep Log and save Mega Man X game data from destruction!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2183650/MEGA_MAN_X_DiVE_Offline/

notes.title: Mega Man Legacy Collection Update Notes
notes.content:
Notes for the 03/15/16 update for Mega Man Legacy Collection:

[list]
[*] Added sound effects to all menus
[*] Added support for the Japanese Rockman versions of all six games
[*] Added Japanese language support
[*] Added Japanese region detection
[/list]

- Added support for the Japanese Rockman versions of all six games

notes.title: Mega Man Legacy Collection Update Available Now
notes.content:
[img]http://images.onesite.com/capcom-unity.com/user/capkel/mega_man/mega_man_legacy_collection/136b9baf903b3c109170fde129bb0359.png?v=202200[/img]

Hey Mega Fans,
 
We've released an update for Mega Man Legacy Collection today that fixes a few minor issues, as well as adds Rockman 1 through 6 (i.e. the Japanese versions of Mega Man). If you run into any bugs or problems after grabbing the update, we encourage you to use our [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/363440/discussions/1/405694115218856894/]Crash / Bug Report Thread[/url] to let us know.

tags.feature: - adds Rockman 1 through 6 (i.e. the Japanese versions of Mega Man).
